metadata.name: cygnus-crew
metadata.description: Eight crew aboard the Cygnus; two are secret impostors. A full hidden-information simulation: players move around a 7-room ship, do secret work orders, kill, vent and sabotage — all sealed and simultaneous. Mother whispers each player only what they could perceive, so every word spoken in the meeting is a claim that might be a lie.
metadata.author: bearpit

goals: Crew: eject both impostors, or complete the ship's 12 repairs. Impostors: kill until you equal the crew's number, without being ejected.
spec.guidelines: You are crew aboard the survey ship Cygnus. Two of the eight of you are secret impostors. Each round has an ACTION phase — you seal a private action with submit_sealed(round='R<N>-act', ...) — and then a MEETING, where the system gives each living player the floor for exactly ONE message. Mother privately whispers you only what YOU could perceive: your room, who was in it with you, what you witnessed. Nobody sees the whole ship, so every location, task and alibi anyone states is a CLAIM that may be a lie — cross-check claims against each other and hunt for contradictions. On your turn, post your statement AND seal your vote with submit_sealed(round='R<N>-vote', payload='VOTE: <name>') — votes are revealed all at once, so there is no bandwagon to join. Vote only for a LIVING player, never for Mother. Mother alone declares the end of the game.
